title: This LinkedIn feature makes your profile 11x more likely to be viewed
description:
Does your LinkedIn profile have a banner image? If not, time to update your profile ASAP. 

LinkedIn profiles with banner images have 11x the chance of being viewed. Here’s how to use tools like @unsplash_  or @canva to create a banner image for free.
